name: nmap
description: Network exploration tool and security / port scanner

options.name: -sL
options.description: List Scan - simply list targets to scan

options.name: -Pn
options.description: Treat all hosts as online -- skip host discovery

options.name: -PS
options.description: TCP SYN discovery to given ports

options.name: -PA
options.description: TCP ACK discovery to given ports

options.name: -PY
options.description: SCTP INIT discovery to given ports

options.name: --traceroute
options.description: Trace hop path to each host

options.name: --exclude-ports
options.description: Exclude the specified ports from scanning

options.name: -F
options.description: Fast mode - Scan fewer ports than the default scan

options.name: -sV
options.description: Probe open ports to determine service/version info

options.name: --allports
options.description: Don't exclude any ports from version detection

options.name: --version-trace
options.description: Show detailed version scan activity (for debugging)

options.name: --osscan-limit
options.description: Limit OS detection to promising targets

options.name: --max-os-tries
options.description: Set the maximum number of OS detection tries against a target

options.name: --script
options.description: Run specified scripts (comma-separated list of directories, script-files or scr…

options.name: --script-args-file
options.description: Load arguments to NSE scripts from a file

options.name: --script-trace
options.description: Show all data sent and received by scripts

options.name: --min-hostgroup
options.description: Minimum parallel host scan group size

options.name: --max-hostgroup
options.description: Maximum parallel host scan group size

options.name: --max-retries
options.description: Caps number of port scan probe retransmissions

options.name: --host-timeout
options.description: Give up on target after this long

options.name: --min-rate
options.description: Send packets no slower than <number> per second

options.name: --max-rate
options.description: Send packets no faster than <number> per second

options.name: --defeat-icmp-ratelimit
options.description: Ignore ICMP unreachable rate limits in UDP

options.name: --nsock-engine
options.description: Enforce use of a given nsock IO multiplexing engine

options.name: -f
options.description: Fragment packets (8 bytes per fragment, use twice for 16)

options.name: --data
options.description: Append a custom payload to sent packets

options.name: --data-string
options.description: Append a custom ASCII string to sent packets

options.name: --data-length
options.description: Append random data to sent packets

options.name: --ip-options
options.description: Send packets with specified IP options

options.name: --badsum
options.description: Send packets with a bogus TCP/UDP/SCTP checksum

options.name: --adler32
options.description: Use deprecated Adler32 instead of CRC32C for SCTP checksums

options.name: -oS
options.description: Output scan in s|<rIpt kIddi3 format

options.name: -oA
options.description: Output in the three major formats at once

options.name: -v
options.description: Increase verbosity level (use -vv or more for greater effect)

options.name: -d
options.description: Increase debugging level (use -dd or more for greater effect)

options.name: --reason
options.description: Display the reason a port is in a particular state

options.name: --packet-trace
options.description: Show all packets sent and received

options.name: --open
options.description: Only show open (or possibly open) ports

options.name: --iflist
options.description: Print host interfaces and routes (for debugging)

options.name: --append-output
options.description: Append to rather than clobber specified output files

options.name: --stylesheet
options.description: XSL stylesheet to transform XML output to HTML

options.name: --webxml
options.description: Reference stylesheet from Nmap.Org for more portable XML

options.name: --no-stylesheet
options.description: Prevent associating of XSL stylesheet w/XML output

options.name: -A
options.description: Enable OS detection, version detection, script scanning, and traceroute

options.name: --datadir
options.description: Specify custom Nmap data file location

options.name: --privileged
options.description: Assume that the user is fully privileged

options.name: --unprivileged
options.description: Assume the user lacks raw socket privileges
